title: Shaping AI Explanations to Expert Perspectives for Scientific Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2603.21846v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI explanations for scientific discovery are typically optimized around a single notion of explanation quality. Experts, however, differ in how they assess evidence, prioritize mechanisms, and judge relevance, meaning that a general-purpose explanation may not provide the evidence an expert finds most informative or convincing. We show that these differences exhibit structured epistemic perspectives and ask whether explanations conditioned on these perspectives are preferred by experts. To study this, we introduce a reinforcement learning-based framework for generating \textit{perspective-conditioned explanations}, which is guided by the judgments of LLM-based personas derived from expert evaluations. We instantiate the framework over scientific knowledge graphs and evaluate it in drug discovery through drug repurposing and drug--target interaction prediction. translated_title: 为科学发现塑造面向专家视角的AI解释
translated_abstract: 科学发现中的AI解释通常围绕单一的解释质量标准进行优化。然而，专家们在评估证据、权衡机制重要性和判断相关性方面存在差异，这意味着通用型解释可能无法提供专家认为最有信息量或最有说服力的证据。我们证明这些差异呈现出结构化的认知视角，并探究以这些视角为条件的解释是否更受专家青睐。为研究这一问题，我们引入了一个基于强化学习的框架，用于生成“视角条件化解释”，该框架由基于专家评估构建的LLM人格化代理的判断来引导。我们在科学知识图谱上实例化该框架，并通过药物再利用和药物-靶点相互作用预测在药物发现领域进行评估。专家研究表明，视角条件化解释能够捕捉（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于强化学习的框架，根据专家的结构化认知视角生成条件化AI解释，使科学知识图谱上的解释（如药物再利用和药物-靶点相互作用预测）更符合不同专家的判断偏好。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-based framework for generating perspective-conditioned AI explanations aligned with experts' structured epistemic perspectives, making scientific explanations on knowledge graphs (e.g., drug repurposing and drug-target interaction prediction) better matched to different experts' judgment preferences.
